data.one_liner: Flutter video player with native engines, HLS/DASH/DRM, caching, PiP, ads and feeds.
data.what_it_does: Better Player provides a single widget that plays video on Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS and Linux using the platform’s native media engine. It supports adaptive streaming, DRM, offline caching, subtitles, picture‑in‑picture, playlists, ads and telemetry.
use_when: You need a production‑grade video player with native performance and advanced features like DRM, caching, PiP and ads.
You want a single package that works across all major platforms without pulling in separate UI or platform plugins.
You need built‑in subtitle support and playlist/feeds for vertical video feeds.
avoid_when: You only need basic video playback and prefer the lightweight video_player package.
You are building a very small demo or prototype and want minimal dependencies.
strengths: Full feature set (DRM, caching, PiP, ads, telemetry)
Federated architecture keeps binary size small
weaknesses: Requires platform‑specific setup for some features (e.g., DRM licenses)
data.setup_notes: Add better_player to pubspec. No build_runner needed. For DRM or caching you may need to add platform permissions (e.g., internet, storage).

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight, core Flutter video playback without extra features.
